RESUME-EDITOR-ESCAPE.scope: Native Escape, focused opener, expanded state, keyboard loop and confined overflow at 320/768/1440. Dirty refusal/outstanding guards preserved statically; no additional runtime credit for those unmodified branches.

IR-WP02-ACK-CAPTURE.title: Dashboard does not acknowledge empty or malformed capture replies and recovers the one real capture
IR-WP02-ACK-CAPTURE.scope: Rejeita ACK vazio ou captureId malformado depois de capture real; retry com o mesmo corpo/chave devolve a captura única e seu histórico autorizado.

IR-WP02-ACK-REVIEW.title: Dashboard requires the requested review sections before acknowledging its real preserved meeting
IR-WP02-ACK-REVIEW.scope: Rejeita ACK vazio ou seções ausentes/divergentes; só confirma a reunião real com as sectionRefs na ordem solicitada. Não fecha WholeReview depois de mudança da fonte.

IR-WP02-ACK-DRAFT.title: Dashboard keeps the draft values and frozen request until its exact next-version receipt arrives
IR-WP02-ACK-DRAFT.scope: Mantém campos privados e tentativa congelada até o draftRef emitido e expectedVersion+1; retry recupera o rascunho real sem alterar Hot Topic ou guardar texto privado no history.

IR-WP02-ACK-PREPARE.title: Dashboard does not acknowledge a preparation for another case choice or revision and replays one real preparation
IR-WP02-ACK-PREPARE.scope: Rejeita ACK de outra incarnation, choice ou próxima versão; retry conserva corpo/chave e recupera uma preparação real. Não aplica domínio durante prepare.

IR-WP02-ACK-APPLY-INCOMPLETE.title: Dashboard rejects an incomplete C12 ACK after the real commit and preserves its unresolved application correlation
IR-WP02-ACK-APPLY-INCOMPLETE.scope: Após commit C12 real, recibo incompleto não limpa revisão/guard/correlação nem anuncia aplicado. Não prova o replay após reload.

IR-WP02-ACK-APPLY-COMPLETE.title: Dashboard acknowledges the complete receipt of one real reviewed application
IR-WP02-ACK-APPLY-COMPLETE.scope: Um ACK integral do produtor real pode concluir a aplicação revisada: sucesso observável, recibo único no caso e efeito real. Contraprova do ramo que sempre recusaria Apply.

IR-WP02-RECOVERY-DRAFT-REVOKED.title: Dashboard recovers a committed draft after response loss, restores only its authorized identity on reload, and fences revoked late discovery
IR-WP02-RECOVERY-DRAFT-REVOKED.scope: Conservar a jornada real e as assertions de autorização, identidade e estado privado. Onde o shell remove o main após revogação, observar também o nó retido/destacado e o main indisponível; exigir controles removidos, history limpo e ausência de re-render tardio.

IR-WP02-RECOVERY-POSTCOMMIT-DENIED.title: Dashboard retains the exact draft attempt when its first response is denied after the real host commits
IR-WP02-RECOVERY-POSTCOMMIT-DENIED.scope: Conservar a jornada real e as assertions de autorização, identidade e estado privado. Onde o shell remove o main após revogação, observar também o nó retido/destacado e o main indisponível; exigir controles removidos, history limpo e ausência de re-render tardio.

IR-WP02-RECOVERY-SOURCE-REPLACED.title: Dashboard clears dirty draft consumers when the source disappears or is replaced under the same id while the case remains readable
IR-WP02-RECOVERY-SOURCE-REPLACED.scope: Conservar a jornada real e as assertions de autorização, identidade e estado privado. Onde o shell remove o main após revogação, observar também o nó retido/destacado e o main indisponível; exigir controles removidos, history limpo e ausência de re-render tardio.

IR-WP02-RECOVERY-CASE-REVOKED.title: Dashboard discards an uncertain private application review when fresh discovery no longer authorizes its case
IR-WP02-RECOVERY-CASE-REVOKED.scope: Conservar a jornada real e as assertions de autorização, identidade e estado privado. Onde o shell remove o main após revogação, observar também o nó retido/destacado e o main indisponível; exigir controles removidos, history limpo e ausência de re-render tardio.

IR-WP01-SHELL-REVOCATION.behavior: Close shell admission on component revocation, scrub connected listeners, then remove DOM/history.

IR-WP01-EDITOR-ESCAPE.behavior: Synchronize aria-expanded at permitted native cancel; preserve outstanding and dirty-discard guards.

IR-WP02-ACK-VALIDATION.behavior: Validate capture/review/draft/prepare/apply ACK shape and explicit identity/version bindings before clearing frozen attempt.

IR-WP02-REVOCATION-CONSUMER-ASSERTIONS.behavior: Preserve local purge assertions on retained nodes and require global absence/history purge.

physicalScope: No timeout, lease, context, exit, EOF, WS, socket or directory assertion was removed or relaxed. A failed consumer is never promoted by cleanup success.
documentaryBinding: Final head is the containing documentary commit. Product/source equality to W2 and the static documentary parent are recorded in verification.json and the PR.
